paite: Jesu, Kha Siangthou in adim a, Jordan lui a kipan akik nawn a, diabol khem kawm in gamdai ah ni sawmli Kha pi in a-om hi.
heading: Jesu Khemna / (Mat 4.1-11; Mar 1.12-13)

paite: Huai nite in bangmah ane kei hi.
Atawp in agil ahong kialta a, diabol in akiang ah, "Pathian Tapa na hihleh hiai suang tanghou suak ding in thu pia in," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Tanghou kia in mihing ahing kei ding, Pathian kam a thupawt in ahing zaw ding," chih gelh ahi, chi in adawng hi.
Huan tang sangtak ah apitou a, mitphiat kal lou in khovel gam tengteng a-ensak hi.
Akiang ah, "Hiai tengteng tung a thuneihna leh athupina ka hon pe ding; ka kiang a piak ahita hi, ka ut peuh kiang ah leng ka pe zel hi.
Huchi in hon bia inla, avek in nang a ahi ding," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Toupa na Pathian na biak ding a, amah nna kia na sep ding ahi," chih gelh ahi, chi in adawng hi.
Huan Jerusalem ah api a, tempul tungzum ah akoih a, akiang ah, "Pathian Tapa na hihleh hiai a kipan kikesak in;
nangmah humbit ding in na tungthu ah zaw a-angelte thu ape ding a,
amau akhut un ahon dom ding uh, huchi lou in zaw na khe in suang na sui kha ding, chih gelh ahi ngal a," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Toupa na Pathian ze-et ke'n," chih gelh ahi, chi in adawng hi.
Huan diabol in akhemna ding teng a akhem khit in alemtan hun chiang a ding in apaisanta hi.
Kha thilhihtheihna in Galili gam ah Jesu apai nawnta a; atanchin huai kim gam teng ah athangta hi.
heading: Galili Gam Ah Jesu'n Nasep Pan / (Mat 4.12-17; Mar 1.14-15)

paite: Huan sinagogte ah thu ahilh zel a, mi tengteng phat in a-om hi.
Huan akhanletna khua Nazaret ahong tung a; Sabbath ni a ahihdan ngeina bang in sinagog ah alut a, sim ding in adingh hi.
heading: Nazaret Ah Jesu Deih Louh In A-om / (Mat 13.53-58; Mar 6.1-6)

paite: Akiang ah zawlnei Isai laibu apia ua, ama'n laibuzial aphel a, hiai thu kigelhna laitak asim hi:

"Liangvaite kiang a Tanchinhoih gen ding a na hon seh ziak in ka tung ah Toupa Kha a-om; ama'n ahon sawl, salte kiang ah pawtna thu leh, mittawte kiang a mitvak neih nawnna thu gen ding, simmoh thuakte pawtsakna ding.
Toupa lungkim kum thu gen ding in," chih.
Huan laibu azial a, nasepsakpa ape nawn a, atuta hi. Huan sinagog a mi tengteng mit atung ah atuta hi.
Akiang uah, "Hiai Laisiangthou thu tuni in na zak un atangtungta," chi in agen pan hi.
Avek un amah aphat ua, akamsuak hehpihna thute lamdang asa mahmah uh, "Hiai mi Joseph tapa ahi kei a hia?" achi uhi.

Ama'n akiang uah, "Nou hiai thupil thu, Daktor, nang leh nang kihihdam in, Kapernaum a na thilhih ka na zak peuh uh, hiai ah nangmah kholam ah leng hih in chi in hon chi khong ding zaw na hi ve ua,” achi hi.
Amah mah in, “Chihtaktak in, ka hon hilh ahi, zawlnei kuamah ama kholam ah pahtawi in a-om ngei kei hi.
Huchi in diktak in ka hon chi ahi, Elijah dam lai a, kum thum leh kha guk van abin a, khovel a kial nakpitak a ahong tun in, Israel gam ah meithai tampi a-om uhi.
Himahleh alak ua kuamah kiang ah Elijah sawl ahi kei, Sidon gam lam a Zarephath a numei, meithai kiang kia a sawl ahi zaw hi.
Huan zawlnei Elishah dam lai in leng Israel gam ah phak tampi a-om ua; himahleh alak uah kuamah hihsiangthou in a-om kei, Siria mi Naaman kia hihsiangthou in a-om zaw hi," achi hi.
Huan sinagog a mi tengteng in huai thute azaktak un, aheh mahmah uhi.
Adingh suausuau ua, khua a kipan in asawnkhia ua, paihkhiak ding in akho omna mual pang ah api uhi.
Himahleh amah alak uah apaisuak a, apaimangta hi.
Huan Galili gam a khua khat, Kapernaum ah ava hohsuk hi. Sabbath ni in mite thu ahilh hi.
heading: Pasal Dawi Nin Pai Hihdamna / (Mar 1.21-28)

paite: Thuneitak a agen ziak in athuhilh lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
Huan sinagog ah dawi nin paimi khat ana om hi.
Amah aw ngaihtak in akikou a, “Eh! Nazaret Jesu, kou leh nang bang ahia i kizolhna om? Hon hihmangthang ding in na hong maw? Nang ka hon thei, Pathian Mi Siangthou na hi," achi hi.
Jesu'n atai a, “Dai inla, asung a kipan pawt in," achi hi. Huan dawi in alai ah ahihpuk a, hihna lou in asung a kipan apawtta hi.
Huan avek un lamdang asa mahmah ua, "Bang thu ahia le? Thuneitak leh thilhihtheitak in dawi ninte thu apia a, apawt uh," chi in akihou uhi.
Huan huai kim gam khua teng ah atanchin athangta hi.
Huan athou a, sinagog a kipan apawt a, Simon inn ah alut hi. Simon zi nu nakpitak in akhosik a, huchi in amah a ding in ana ngetsak uhi.
heading: Simon Zi Nu leh Mi Tampi Hihdamna / (Mat 8.14-17; Mar 1.29-34)

paite: Akiang ah adingh a, khosik atai a, adaita hi; athou pah a, a-nna uh asepsakta hi.
Huan nitum kuan in natna tuamtuam a na, damlou nei peuhmah in akiang ah ahon pi ua; avek un atung uah akhut akoih chiat a, ana hihdam zel hi.
Huan dawite'n leng, "Pathian Tapa na hi," chi a kikou in, mi tampi sung a kipan in hong pawt uhi. Huan amau atai a, Khrist ahi chih atheih ziak un apau uh aphal kei hi.
Huan khovak tak in apawt a, kuamah omlouhna mun ah ahoh a; mipite'n azong ua, akiang ah ahong ua, amau apaisanlouhna ding in let atum uhi.
heading: Sinagog Ah Jesu'n Thu Gen / (Mar 1.35-39)

paite: Himahleh akiang uah, "Kho dang ah leng Pathian lalgam tanchinhoih ka hilh ding ahi, huai ding a sawl ka hi ngal a,” achi hi.
Huchi in Galili gam a sinagogte ah thu ahilhta hi.
